name: abovebeyond

plugins.name: agent-scan
plugins.description: Scan everything in your repo that acts on its own - agents, LLM calls, MCP servers, bots, scheduled jobs - and score it on the PAC framework's six profiler axes, with file:line evidence and one verdict line.

plugins.name: hallucination-scan
plugins.description: Scan every path where model output reaches a human or a decision, and score what stands in between - nothing, review, structure, or a verification gate (the ProveML bar). File:line evidence, one verdict line.

description: Above Beyond's Claude Code plugins: /agent-scan (what acts on its own, scored on PAC) and /hallucination-scan (what speaks unchecked, scored on ProveML).
